items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: So what I've done, I hired Wiggins and I played the banjo.

ctx.x: So yeah, speaking about Earl Wiggins, hasn't he got that band at Lufkin's now?

Yeah, well I hired him, you see what I mean? I hired him. Because I was playing piano down there. But the trouble is when I was playing the piano down there, we couldn't get a guitar player nowhere. So what I've done, I hired Wiggins and I played the banjo.
Well he's got a little band there.
